name: Pet to Human
description: Your pet as an invented human character with the same colors and personality; then they look at the camera and grin. With a before/after reveal.

photo.label: A clear photo of your pet

fixed.motion_prompt.text: They look at the camera and grin. Smooth, natural motion; the subject stays recognisable. This one person is alone in the picture, seen from the shoulders up. Only the face moves; the shoulders stay still. Static shot: the camera holds steady and the background stays still.
fixed.keyframe_prompt.text: Image 1 is a blurred colour guide made from a photo of a pet. Make a portrait photo of an invented human character with the same colors and personality: an invented adult whose hair colour echoes the main colours of image 1 and whose clothes echo its other colours, in a similar setting and light. A fully human face with human ears, a human nose and smooth bare human skin. A natural friendly expression. An ordinary invented person with an original face. A head-and-shoulders portrait of one person alone. Photorealistic, vertical portrait framing, high detail, a clean unmarked photo.
